methodology.workload: Issue #155 generated fixture: index page becomes interactive, then catalog/17 in a second tab.
methodology.timing: Default watchers, module census disabled, fresh fixture/output/server/browser per trial. OS filesystem caches are not flushed. Browser launch precedes the startup clock. Startup and request metrics are separate.
methodology.order: Reverse arm order on alternating iterations; warmups excluded.
methodology.controls: eager and candidate use the same checkout and dependencies; stock uses the supplied pre-PR checkout. All arms assert HTTP 200, SSR content, hydrated click handlers, retained text/document, and no activation reload/HDR message.
